messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Sales surfaced a Fortune-class customer (FinBank) asking for: zero-downtime operator upgrades, preservation of public IPs during upgrades, and an air-gapped installer variant. They want launch timeline and gating criteria by EOD Friday. Can the product team triage?
Priya Suresh: +1. We should treat this as a priority-risk request, but scope carefully — we already have partial flows for upgrade rollouts.
Samir Patel: Agree. Key tradeoffs: true zero-downtime will need staged control-plane handover and a migration path for node certificates. Preserving public IPs is mostly networking (IPAM/peerings) + installer semantics for not recreating load balancers.
Morgan Lee: From packaging POV: we can add an "ip-preserve" flag to the installer to skip LB replace. Need to ensure operator understands older control-plane pods will remain reachable.
Jin Park: On air-gapped: we have the offline bundle generator in the repo but it lacks a signed-manifest + offline dependency checksum step customers want for auditors.
Lina Gómez: Field asks also include: clarity in rollback window (max 15 min), preflight validator that checks firewall whitelists and NAT rules, and a deterministic upgrade plan for cluster-by-cluster patching.
Priya Suresh: Proposal: create a scoped initiative "VPC Upgrade Safety" with three deliverables — (1) Zero-downtime upgrade pattern (canary+shadow), (2) IP-preserve installer option + doc, (3) Air-gapped signed bundle + preflight validator. Prioritize (2) then (1) then (3) for Q2.
Samir Patel: Quick technical note: (1) requires KV-cache handoff semantics for the runtime and session affinity shim. This impacts runtime teams. We'll need an API for 'drain-preserve' in the operator.
Morgan Lee: For (2) I sketched a CLI change: ```redwood-installer apply --ip-preserve --skip-lb-replace``` plus a post-install hook that does ipam sanity checks. We'll need tests in the e2e matrix for both AWS and GCP.
Alex Chen: Good. Can we agree on launch criteria for each deliverable? I suggest: (2) Installer IP-preserve: pass e2e across 2 clouds, documented rollback steps, and 3 pilot customers signed up. (1) Zero-downtime upgrade pattern: internal canary + 1 paying customer beta, SLO impact <5% increase in p50. (3) Air-gap signed bundle: offline checksum verification, signed manifest, and security review complete.
Jin Park: I'll own (3) technical work for the signed manifest + checksum tooling. ETA 6 weeks if no blockers.
Samir Patel: I'll own operator changes for (1). Need runtime time from eng-runtime (cc @Morgan for packaging). Estimated 8 weeks if we parallelize cert migration work.
Morgan Lee: I'll own (2) and the e2e tests. I can frontload a minimal prototype this week to prove skipping LB replacement.
Lina Gómez: I'll draft a short "field launch checklist" for customer handoff with required netops signoff, rollback window, and IP ownership checklist.
Priya Suresh: Prioritization note: We should require an internal cross-team review before committing pilots. Add "networking preflight" to the gating checklist.
Alex Chen: Action items: Samir + Morgan + Jin + Lina to sync tomorrow 10am PT. Priya will sign off on prioritization afterwards. I will notify Sales.
Tess (release-bot): New meeting created: #VPC-upgrade-safety-sync at 10:00 AM PT tomorrow. Agenda: ownership, launch criteria, risk matrix.
eng-prod-bot: CI: packaging-offline-bundle build #482 succeeded (artifact available).
Samir Patel: One more operational requirement: we must document a clear fallback policy when public IPs cannot be preserved (e.g., customer NAT / ISP refuses updates). That goes into the rollback docs and sales playbook.
Priya Suresh: +1 — requirement: explicit sign-off checkbox in customer runbook that IP-preserve was verified before upgrade.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. If anyone thinks scope should be narrower for initial rollout, flag now. Otherwise we'll run with the three-deliverable plan and get a draft PRD by Wed.
Lina Gómez: Noted. I'll upload the checklist draft to the roadmap folder and tag the field team.
Jin Park: Quick config snippet for signed bundle generator for reviewers: ```./bundle-gen --model-lockfile bundle.lock --signer-key /keys/team.pem --output bundle.tar.gz --manifest bundle.json```
Morgan Lee: I'll add e2e jobs: aws-ip-preserve, gcp-ip-preserve, and onprem-smoke.
Samir Patel: For testing operator drain-preserve, we'll need a fixture to simulate active KV-cache sessions; adding that to test backlog.
Priya Suresh: OK — PRD target Wed, pilots targeted in 6-9 weeks pending resource approval.
Alex Chen: Great. I'll post a short note to Sales and field with the plan and tentative timelines. :thumbsup:
eng-prod-bot: Reminder: please attach risk matrix to PRD before review.
Lina Gómez: Will do — sending draft link in morning.
